title: HealthMarket
tagline: HealthMarket - Bundle and sell your Health Records to the highest bidder.
description:
You do not have your medical history collected in one place.
Collecting data is labor intensive.
You require incentives to make this labor worthwhile.
HealthMarket allows you to bundle HealthRecords that you collect from every blood test and sell it to the highest bidder on the auction.
This gives you reward for looking after yourself while also assisting researchers.
how_its_made:
We deployed our contracts to Polygon. We deployed a ERC-721 contract that was later sold via Zora Offers. We implemented a Registry contract that returns the list of approved NFT.
We used Hardhat to work on the contracts, usually TDD-style. Our frontend is done with React.  We use useDapp library.
